messages.subject: wrong color of the plots
parts:
Hello:

I have the following code, the code works except the color of the
plot, it is red instead of blue.

PHXIV<-ggplot(data=PPCHXIV,aes(STIM,meanpct,lty=2,group=group))
+geom_line()+geom_point(data=HXIV,aes(STIM,DV,colour =
"blue",group=ID))

same thing happens when I was trying to fill a geom_ribbon like the
following code, it is filled with red.

PHXIV+geom_ribbon(data=PPCHXIV,aes(x=STIM, ymin=pctll,
ymax=pctul,group=group,alpha=0.2, fill="blue"))

Thanks

>
> PHXIV<-ggplot(data=PPCHXIV,aes(STIM,meanpct,lty=2,group=group))
> +geom_line()+geom_point(data=HXIV,aes(STIM,DV,colour =
> "blue",group=ID))
>
> same thing happens when I was trying to fill a geom_ribbon like the
> following code, it is filled with red.
>
> PHXIV+geom_ribbon(data=PPCHXIV,aes(x=STIM, ymin=pctll,
> ymax=pctul,group=group,alpha=0.2, fill="blue"))

You need

PHXIV<-ggplot(data=PPCHXIV,aes(STIM,meanpct,lty=2,group=group))
+geom_line()+geom_point(data=HXIV,aes(STIM,DV,group=ID),colour="blue")

and similarly for your other example.

i.e. colour is not an aesthetic but a fixed value.
